definition: At a world w: FactPSR says every fact true there has a reason; ContingentPSR says every contingent truth there has a reason; ExistencePSR says the existence fact of every existent there has a reason; NoBrute says no contingent truth there lacks a reason. None says a reason is good, external or necessitating.
